scope: Exact equality on all compactly supported smooth test functions.
argument: For finite self-adjoint matrices, the trace of each unitary flow is a finite exponential sum and therefore a real-analytic function of the flow parameter.
The difference of two such traces is again represented by a real-analytic function and has no atomic singular support.
The prime-power side is a locally finite distribution with nonzero atoms at off-origin logarithmic prime-power locations.
Distributions with different singular supports cannot be equal.
boundary: The obstruction does not rule out finite truncations, infinite-dimensional distributional traces, or counterterms declared independently of the forbidden comb.
